about: Client tools for the Allowance ElevenLabs agent. Create each one in the ElevenLabs agent's Tools section with Tool Type = Client and 'Wait for response' ticked; names and parameter identifiers are case-sensitive and must match the frontend's clientTools handlers. Each handler calls the backend with the AGENT session token only. See docs/VOICE_INTEGRATION.md.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Find prediction-market events by keywords, such as team names or a topic. Free. Returns each event's ticker, title and current odds. Always call this first to get a ticker.
tools.returnToAgent: Up to 5 results: ticker, title, and each contract's label, bestBid, bestAsk.

tools.name: list_catalog
tools.description: List the paid data products, their prices in USDC and who sells them. Free.

tools.name: buy
tools.description: Request a paid data product for one event. The backend's spending policy decides: it may pay automatically, hold the purchase for the person's approval, or block it. Never assume it was paid; read 'state' and 'next' in the response.

parameters.description: One of: odds_snapshot, odds_history, deep_brief, full_report.

body.idempotencyKey: <generated by the frontend: one new UUID per tool invocation, reused on retries of that invocation>

tools.returnToAgent: id, state, priceUsdc, reason, next, summary. Omit `result` unless the agent needs detail.

tools.name: get_purchase
tools.description: Read the current state of a purchase, and its data once paid. Use after the person approves a held purchase, or when the state was pending.
tools.returnToAgent: id, state, priceUsdc, reason, next, summary.

tools.name: check_budget
tools.description: Report today's spending limit, how much is committed, what remains, the auto-approve limit, and whether spending is frozen.
tools.returnToAgent: dailyCapUsdc, committedTodayUsdc, remainingTodayUsdc, autoApproveMaxUsdc, availableFundsUsdc, frozen, frozenReason.

deliberatelyNotTools.approve: Operator-only button in the app (POST /api/purchases/:id/approve with an operator session).
